intro.new-cairo: East of Cairo, home to the Fifth and First Settlements. Egypt's largest market for residential compounds, close to the Ring Road and 90th Street.
intro.sheikh-zayed: West of Cairo next to 6th of October: calm compounds and green space near the Cairo–Alexandria Desert Road and 26th of July Corridor.
intro.new-capital: The New Administrative Capital east of Cairo, with the government and business districts and many residential, office and retail projects.
intro.north-coast: The Mediterranean coast: summer and hotel projects from west of Alexandria to El Alamein and Ras El Hekma.
intro.ain-sokhna: Ain Sokhna on the Gulf of Suez, a short drive from Cairo, with chalets and resorts on the Red Sea.
intro.mostakbal-city: Mostakbal City between New Cairo and the New Capital on the Suez Road: new residential projects at lower prices than New Cairo.
intro.6th-of-october: 6th of October City west of Cairo, one of the largest new cities, with residential and commercial projects and many universities.

budget.title: Tell us what you have. We'll show you what it buys.
budget.text: Most sites ask for a unit price. We ask what actually matters: the cash you have for the down payment and the installment you can pay each month. We check it against every unit type and every payment plan.
budget.filterHint: We work out the down payment and installment for every unit type and plan.
budget.emptyBudget: No unit in these projects fits this budget. Try a higher down payment or installment, or remove other filters.
budget.note: Approximate: (unit price − down payment − handover payment) ÷ months, from the developer's published prices.

calculator.title: Work out your plan in pounds
calculator.sub: Pick a unit type and a payment plan to see every pound you'll pay, and when.
calculator.titleDollars: Work out your plan in dollars
calculator.subDollars: Pick a unit type and a payment plan to see every dollar you'll pay, and when.
calculator.note: Approximate figures from the developer's published prices and plans. AqarArena adds no commission or interest.

forDevelopersPage.metaTitle: For developers: the portal and AqarArena Sales
forDevelopersPage.metaDescription: Show your projects, prices and units on AqarArena for free, and give your sales team their own AqarArena Sales accounts on the same data.
forDevelopersPage.title: Put your projects in front of serious buyers, with your own numbers
forDevelopersPage.sub: AqarArena is a neutral guide to every project in Egypt. Add your projects, prices, payment plans and photos from your company's own portal, and buyers reach you directly, with no broker.

benefits.title: Only your official numbers
benefits.text: Every call and WhatsApp button on your project page goes to your hotline and sales team, never to a broker.

benefits.title: No commission
benefits.text: We only show projects. We don't sell, and we take no cut of any sale.

benefits.title: Always up to date
benefits.text: Update prices, payment plans and photos any time; visitors see when they were last updated.

benefits.title: Fair comparison
benefits.text: Your project appears in budget search, on the map and in comparisons, on the same terms as every other.

steps.title: Request an account
steps.text: Enter your company details and choose a username and password. We check the request and activate the account.

steps.title: Add your projects
steps.text: For each project: details, unit types with areas and prices, payment plans, photos, master plan and brochure.

steps.title: We review and publish
steps.text: Our team checks every addition and change for accuracy, and it goes live as soon as we approve it.

includes: Projects and their location on the map
Unit types with areas and prices

Master plan, floor plans and brochure
forDevelopersPage.closingText: Accounts are free. All you need is your company's details; add your projects at your own pace.
forDevelopersPage.portalNote: The developer portal and AqarArena Sales are in Arabic.

portalCard.title: Developer portal
portalCard.text: Show your projects on AqarArena: details, prices, payment plans, photos and master plan. And see each project's visitors.

salesCard.title: AqarArena Sales
salesCard.text: A tool for your sales team: every salesperson has their own account, opens your projects and sees how many units are available in each project. Coming soon: inventory search, temporary holds and PDF offers.
salesCard.cta: Talk to us about AqarArena Sales

forDevelopersPage.salesTitle: Your team sells from the same data
forDevelopersPage.salesSub: The same projects and units as the site, in your sales team's hands. Unit status you change in the inventory reaches them at once.

salesFeatures.title: An account per salesperson
salesFeatures.text: Each person has their own username and password; you add and disable them from the portal.

salesFeatures.title: Your projects and their available units
salesFeatures.text: Each salesperson opens your projects and sees how many units are available in each, from the same data as the portal.

salesFeatures.title: Inventory search
salesFeatures.text: By budget, bedrooms, floor and view, with only available units shown.

salesFeatures.title: Temporary holds
salesFeatures.text: A unit is held for one salesperson for a set time, and is released automatically if not confirmed.

salesFeatures.title: PDF offers
salesFeatures.text: With the payment schedule installment by installment and the salesperson's name and numbers, sent by WhatsApp, Telegram or email.

salesFeatures.title: Clients and follow-ups
salesFeatures.text: Every client with their offers, holds and follow-up dates, and the team lead sees them all.

contactPage.title: Contact us
contactPage.intro: Have a suggestion or a complaint, need help, or have a request? Write to us and we'll get back to you soon.
contactPage.responseTime: We usually reply within two working days.
contactPage.notBroker: AqarArena is not a broker: for bookings or final prices, contact the developer directly from the project page.
contactPage.developersNote: A developer who wants to list projects?
contactPage.name: Name
contactPage.messageHint: Add the details; if it's about a project, include its name.
contactPage.privacy: We only use your details to reply to you, as explained in our privacy policy.
